# Recorded quota fixtures

Synthesized fixtures shaped like the app-server `account/rateLimits/read`
response and the `account/rateLimits/updated` notification, using the live
values in the parent design note (a `promax` plan with a 10,080-minute
primary window at about 1% used). No upstream fixture files existed to
copy; the mapping rules they pin come from the MIT-licensed t3code
provider usage-limits modules (see `../../LICENSE-t3code`). Account
identifiers, paths and addresses are synthetic.
